question: Do scene-grouped REPID loser-to-winner pairs identify one reusable source-free bounded global colour operator after exact ProPhoto-to-sRGB normalization?

ingress.profile_description: Reference Output Medium Metric (ROMM) / ProPhoto RGB
ingress.conversion: ICC relative-colorimetric to sRGB code before fitting

fit.operator: sigmoid(M logit(x) + b), one shared 3x3 M plus 3-vector b
fit.dose_selection: lowest fit target RMSE among matrix-safe candidates; ties choose lower dose

controls: per-channel diagonal logit-affine at identical ridge and sampling
scene-cyclic label-permuted winner targets at identical capacity
reverse-direction shared logit-affine applied in the forward direction
stop_rules: Any acquisition, ICC, implementation or replay mismatch invalidates execution before fitting.
Any matrix gate failure closes without ridge, dose, coordinate or model rescue.
Any calibration gate failure closes before sealed image acquisition.
No role-specific router, higher-order operator, threshold relaxation or same-cohort rescue is allowed.
claim_ceiling: private internal-research shared professional-render colour-prior D0; not film, stock, scanner, calibrated authenticity, arbitrary-image preference, package, capability or product evidence
